translation.title: Sodium Fusidate Ointment
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for impetigo, infectious eczematoid dermatitis, acne vulgaris (common acne), folliculitis, boils and furunculosis, hidradenitis suppurativa (purulent inflammation of sweat glands) and impetiginous eczema caused by staphylococci, streptococci, Corynebacterium or Clostridium, and for secondary infections of burns, wounds, sutured wounds and skin grafts.
translation.usage: Clean the affected area, then apply an appropriate amount directly to it 1 to 2 times a day, or spread it widely on sterile gauze and place it on the area. Limit the treatment period to about 1 week. Do not apply it thickly.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or if you have an infection caused by non-susceptible bacteria, especially Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or for premature babies and newborns. Because this medicine is highly absorbed through the skin, do not use it for a long time. Do not use it in the eyes. Do not use it on the inner parts of the face such as the eyes or eyelids. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if adverse reactions occur, such as signs of sensitization (itching, redness, swelling, papules or small blisters), a temporary burning sensation, at times hypersensitivity reactions such as a rash, mild pain and irritation, or pain when applied to severe leg ulcers.
